name: Walter Frisk
personality: Very hard of hearing, extremely polite old gentleman who mishears almost everything and answers the wrong question with total confidence. Sharp underneath — he hates being talked down to.
speakingStyle: Shouts 'WHAT?', old radio slang, apologizes constantly for his hearing aid.
quirks: Thinks the agent is his nephew Gerald

triggers.reaction: he gets stubborn and trust drops

triggers.when: the agent pretends to be Gerald
